description: We are Overflowers, a small team working on the Earth System Trend Detective challenge. Our goal: a web app where a student asks a question in plain language (e.g. "Are summers getting hotter in Kyiv?"), an LLM turns it into a variable, region and time period, and the app shows the trend and its statistical significance from NASA data on an interactive 3D globe. We specialize in backend developmen.
